input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets our preferred position on every material term: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1); Deliverables materially conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after the later of delivery or acceptance, and Hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term (which exceeds the 12-month software benchmark) (19.2); Vendor warrants compliance with Applicable Law and no intentionally introduced malicious code (19.3). The remedy in 19.4 is meaningful — prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, escalating to termination of the affected item plus refund of Fees paid, and expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty. Acceptance testing in Section 6 (fifteen business days, no deemed acceptance by payment or silence, refund after two failed correction cycles) reinforces rather than undercuts the warranty. No redline required.
